hero.role: Full-stack engineer building fast, quiet software.
hero.pitch: I design and ship web products end to end — from database schema to the last pixel of the interface. Lately: developer tools, dashboards, and systems that stay fast under real load.

about.title: Background & approach
about.p1: I started out fixing WordPress themes for friends and ended up leading platform teams at two Series-B startups. I care about systems that are boring in the right places — predictable deploys, readable code, dashboards nobody has to babysit.
about.p2: Outside of work I write short technical notes on distributed systems and mentor junior engineers switching into backend roles.
